description: Find known infinite combos and synergistic card combinations from Commander Spellbook. Use this when a user asks about combos involving specific cards, combos in specific colors, or wants to find win conditions. Returns combo steps, prerequisites, and results.

card_name.description: Single card name to search combos for

card_names.description: Multiple card names to search combos for

color_identity.description: Filter combos within this color identity (e.g. ["W","U","B"])

name: find_combos
